meta.revisionPolicy: Each ILOEST edition re-estimates the whole modelled history; the raw dump of the previous edition is archived under data/raw/vintages. Survey series change when the ILO reprocesses the unit data.
meta.note: ILO modelled estimates. Each observation is imputed by the ILO's model unless flagged R (a real value from national data); the ILO says imputed observations are subject to high uncertainty. Each yearly edition re-estimates the whole history.
